build_siglip2_vision_model: build a Siglip2VisionModel to encode variable-resolution images using NaFlex support
create_siglip2_vision_embeddings: create Siglip2VisionEmbeddings to embed patchified pixel values with positional embeddings for variable-resolution images
run_siglip2_vision_transformer: run the Siglip2VisionTransformer forward pass on packed pixel values with spatial shapes and cu_seqlens
test_resolve_visual_encoder_outputs: test resolve_visual_encoder_outputs to select hidden states from specific encoder layers and concatenate them
load_siglip2_weights: load Siglip2Model weights with stacked QKV parameter mapping and out_proj renaming support
